scenes.sub: Interpret exchange inflows and outflows with the right caveats.

scenes.sub: Inflows to exchanges may precede selling (or collateral posting, internal moves). Outflows may mean self-custody or DeFi use. Netflow = inflows − outflows. Exchange reserves on-chain aren't proof of solvency (liabilities aren't visible).

scenes.sub: Netflow +20,000 ETH in a day. Before concluding "selling pressure": check if it's one exchange reshuffling, whether derivatives open interest rose (collateral), and whether price and volume confirm. One metric is a hypothesis, not a signal.
